summary: Allow replicated host migration during active resumable peer exchanges

replay.detail: No replay changes. Received exchange pages remain durable and resume admission and inventory reconciliation after restart.

rules.detail: Host migration retains zero pending replication records, verified first sync when present, and the configured checkpoint-worker gate. It no longer requires all peer workers to report idle or backoff simultaneously. Peer phases are not a write fence; received pages commit transactionally and retries deduplicate envelopes.

compatibility.detail: No daemon or wire upgrade required. Existing service ordering still stops replication auxiliaries before the daemon and fences state/store ownership before moving the complete store.

downtime.detail: No additional wait or polling; existing bounded service cutover is unchanged.

manual.detail: Retry a previously refused migrate host dry-run with the updated mover; no manual worker stop is required.

recovery.detail: Existing readiness-based migration rollback remains available. Revert this change to restore the simultaneous peer-phase gate.
